principles: Use clear, calm, and factual language.
Do not guarantee safety or outcomes.
Prioritize clarity over completeness in short channels.
mandatory_inclusions: Include location and timestamp when available.
Include a link placeholder if available.
Always include: 'Call emergency services if in immediate danger.'
global_messaging_rules.data_handling: If required inputs are missing, use the fallback template without inventing details.

tone_presets.calm_reassuring: Steady, supportive, and composed. Emphasizes reassurance without minimizing risk.
tone_presets.urgent_clear: Direct and concise. Focused on immediate actions without alarmist language.
tone_presets.command_operational: Formal, authoritative, and task-oriented. Suitable for coordinated response.

templates.title: I'm Safe Update
templates.template_text: Update from {user_name}: I am safe following the earthquake near {quake_place}. Current location: {user_location}. Time: {timestamp}. More info: {geo_guard_link}. Call emergency services if in immediate danger.
templates.safety_notes: Do not state others are safe unless confirmed.
templates.fallback_template: I am safe after the earthquake. Location and details may be limited. Time: {timestamp}. Call emergency services if in immediate danger.

templates.title: Stuck in Red Zone
templates.template_text: URGENT from {user_name}: I am in the high-risk zone near the earthquake at {quake_place}. I may be stuck. Location: {user_location} (lat:{lat}, lng:{lng}). Time: {timestamp}. {geo_guard_link}. Call emergency services if in immediate danger.
templates.safety_notes: Encourage contacts to call emergency services if no response.
templates.fallback_template: URGENT: I am in the affected zone of the earthquake near {quake_place}. I may need help. Time: {timestamp}. Call emergency services if in immediate danger.

templates.title: Need Help SOS
templates.template_text: SOS from {user_name}. I need assistance at {user_location} (lat:{lat}, lng:{lng}). Earthquake near {quake_place}. Time: {timestamp}. Details: {geo_guard_link}. Call emergency services if in immediate danger.
templates.safety_notes: Encourage direct emergency calls when possible.
templates.fallback_template: SOS: I need help due to the earthquake. Location unclear. Time: {timestamp}. Call emergency services if in immediate danger.

templates.title: Injured – Medical Needed
templates.template_text: Medical assistance needed. Injured person at {user_location}. Nearest hospital: {nearest_hospital}. Earthquake details: M{quake_mag} near {quake_place}. Time: {timestamp}. {geo_guard_link}. Call emergency services if in immediate danger.
templates.safety_notes: Do not describe injuries beyond confirmed observations.
templates.fallback_template: Medical help needed due to earthquake. Location uncertain. Time: {timestamp}. Call emergency services if in immediate danger.

templates.title: Trapped – Rescue Needed
templates.template_text: Rescue needed: person trapped at {user_location} (lat:{lat}, lng:{lng}). Earthquake near {quake_place}. Time: {timestamp}. Access notes: {safe_route_summary}. {geo_guard_link}. Call emergency services if in immediate danger.
templates.fallback_template: Rescue needed due to earthquake. Person may be trapped. Location unclear. Time: {timestamp}. Call emergency services if in immediate danger.
